message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine features a red background. In the upper-right, a light-skinned man wearing a tan shirt and a black "peci" cap looks upward with an open mouth and closed eyes. His left hand is raised, supporting a large white speech bubble. In the lower-left, a second man with dark skin and a shaved head is shown in profile from the chest up, looking toward the right. He wears a white shirt and holds up both hands, palms out, as if supporting a even larger white speech bubble that occupies the center-right.

The magazine title "TEMPO" is centered at the top in large black serif letters. Below it, small black text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN". To the left of this, white text reads "MULUTMU HARIMAUMU". Smaller white text below lists several words including "SONTOLOYO, GENDERUWO, TAMPANG BOYOLALI, TEMPE SETIPIS KARTU ATM" and mentions "KAMPANYE 2019." The top edge contains white text: "KEJARLAH DAKU, JAKSA KUTANGKAP" and "MERPATI BERSIAP TERBANG LAGI." A barcode and date "3-9 DESEMBER 2018" appear at the bottom-left.
